Preserve and clarify intent: Keep the title, gold counter, four exact menu destinations, and centered mystical hero, but strengthen the summoning event with a luminous ritual seal or altar beneath the spirit, a clearer spectral face/body edge, and particles visibly emerging through the veil. Keep every brief-required object, label, control, state, and relationship visible inside 1280×800; do not trade compliance for a cleaner crop.

Reposition and rescale existing elements rather than deleting them; allow one primary focal region, one supporting information tier, and quiet utility controls.

Implementation guardrails: edit the existing self-contained HTML/CSS/JS; use no remote assets, libraries, fonts, APIs, canvas packages, or network calls. Keep the fixed viewport at 1280×800 with no scrolling. Preserve all functioning content and verify small text, edge safety, and component alignment after the revision.
